Deposit burning splits honest from fake. Honest get it back, fakers watch it burn.

Each slot escrows 90 units, locked 3 epochs. VRF draws 7 jurors each epoch; failed proofs pile as shale. A fake slot burns its deposit; a second offense freezes all 20 epochs.

Honest: 1,000 workers lock 90,000, get it back. Faker: the same 1,000 lock 90,000; at 30% fakes, 27,000 burn. Loss peaks at the vertex, the second offense; a sparrow's work is free.
